Identical /output paths in different workers refer to separate directories. The enforced helper is read-only at /guardian/notify-launch; copies under /output are ordinary task artifacts. history_retrieval.scope: Lexical retrieval of earlier evidence, not semantic completeness, current permissions or proof of intent. Excerpts are copied from verified source files; omitted context remains on disk.
